summary: Coherent complex analytification, analytic cohomology, projective and proper GAGA, algebraization, and de Rham–Betti comparison, including relative Hodge and regular-singular logarithmic interfaces. Unavailable supplier interfaces and the precise proof references still to be verified are explicit leaves, not claims of formalization.

Addition and multiplication descend and preserve analyticity.

nodes.title: Convergent Weierstrass division

proofSteps: Choose a small contour enclosing the d zeros with f nonzero on it.
Cauchy division produces holomorphic coefficient functions and quotient on a smaller polydisc.
The residue formula and uniqueness for a distinguished polynomial give uniqueness; formal division alone supplies no convergence.

Hahn–Banach and Riesz represent the functional ∂̄*v↦⟨v,g⟩; elliptic regularity gives the smooth minimal solution.

nodes.title: Finite-mass extension of closed positive currents
nodes.statement: Let E be a closed complete pluripolar subset of a complex manifold and T a closed positive current on its complement with locally finite mass near E.
